chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from one of the two عليهما السلام, who said:
The pilgrim should not take provisions from his sacrificial animal, but he may eat in Mina. He said: and this is the issue of Shihab; he wrote to him about it.

key_terms.أُضْحِيَّتِهِ: his sacrificial animal offered during hajj
key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Mina, the hajj location where sacrifice is performed
key_terms.شِهَابٍ: Shihab, the person associated with the question

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim take meat from his sacrificial animal out of Mina as provisions?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the sacrificial offering during hajj, indicating that the pilgrim should not carry away meat from his udhiyah as provisions. At the same time, it permits him to eat from it in Mina, showing a distinction between consuming it there and taking it away.
